Lords Piece

• Lords Piece is a fan-made action RPG inspired by powerful abilities and characters from many popular anime universes.
🎮 Controls

• W / A / S / D – Move
• SHIFT – Sprint
• Double Space – Double Jump
• Q – Dash
• ALT – Shift Lock
• M – Menu
• R - Obs Haki
• T - Arm Haki
 Level Cap: 2500
⚔️ Available Powers
• 36 Combat
• 35 Abilities
• 4 Lord - 4 Evolve Lord

PC & CONSOLE & MOBILE
